subject: Re: Next steps & eval kickoff — Finlytics trial plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finlytics.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & eval kickoff — Finlytics trial plan

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Finlytics production workloads (low-latency embeddings + cost optimization for batch scoring).
- Key constraints: throughput target ~200 QPS at 1.5s p95, data residency in us-west-2, SOC2 evidence needed for procurement.
- Stakeholders: Samantha (product), Carlos (SRE/infra), Priya (data science) — please correct me if I missed anyone.

Recommended next step: 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff to walk the trial plan, agree success criteria, and align a prompt/eval set. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 25 — 10:00–11:15 AM
- Wed Aug 26 — 2:00–3:15 PM (preferred)
- Thu Aug 27 — 9:00–10:15 AM

Agenda (what we'll cover):
1) Trial plan & timeline (what we deliver week-by-week)
2) Success criteria (latency/cost/quality targets + pass/fail gating)
3) Prompt set / eval methodology (baseline prompts + metrics we'll measure)
4) Technical deep dive (networking, auth, VPC options) — Marissa will lead
5) Next steps & calendar invites

Attachments: finlytics_trial_plan_v1.pdf (trial plan, timeline, responsibilities), finlytics_prompt_set.xlsx (initial prompt set / eval cases). Also linking the Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/finlytics/trial-plan

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Carlos + Priya should be included for the technical portions? If none of the times work, tell me your preferred windows and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://www.redwood.com

Attachments: finlytics_trial_plan_v1.pdf (proposal), finlytics_prompt_set.xlsx (initial prompts)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & eval kickoff — Finlytics trial plan

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. Wed Aug 26 2:00–3:15 PM PDT works best for us, would you be able to lock that?

We definitely want a technical deep dive (networking/VPC and perf tuning). I will have Carlos (SRE) on the call; I'll also try to bring Priya (data science) for the prompt/quality discussion. Our infra runs primarily in AWS us-west-2.

One ask before the kickoff: can you include a short section in the plan about how Redwood handles KV/prefix caching and how cache warmup will be measured during the trial? That will help Carlos prepare.

Thanks — Sam

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & eval kickoff — Finlytics trial plan

Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks — I've booked Wed Aug 26 2:00–3:15 PM PDT and sent a calendar invite (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finlytics-eval-kickoff). Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) will lead the technical deep dive portion and walk through the caching/kv warmup measurements you asked about.

Proposed kickoff agenda (finalized):
- 0:00–0:10 — Introductions & success criteria alignment
- 0:10–0:35 — Trial plan & timeline (Connor)
- 0:35–1:05 — Prompt set and eval metrics (Priya / Connor)
- 1:05–1:25 — Technical deep dive: networking, VPC options, KV/prefix cache behavior & warmup measurement (Marissa)
- 1:25–1:35 — Open Q&A and next steps

Deliverables for the kickoff:
- Finalized trial plan PDF (attached)
- Shared prompt/eval spreadsheet (attached)
- Baseline runbooks for KV caching + measurement checklist (we'll share before the call)

If there are specific success criteria you want written into the kickoff doc (e.g., p95 target, max cost per 1k tokens, embedding recall threshold), reply with those and I'll add them to the agenda and the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/FD-2026-0042

See you Wed Aug 26 — invite lists me, Marissa, and (if you confirm) Priya/Carlos.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
